title: Sunil Kumar v. State (fictional)
text:
1. FICTIONAL JUDGMENT FOR THE MANU DEMO. This is not a real decision and is not law. The question is whether the right to default bail survives when the chargesheet is filed after the period expired but before the application is decided.

2. The right accrues on expiry of the period if no chargesheet is filed. It is enforced by an application made before the chargesheet is filed.

3. An application made after the chargesheet is filed does not revive a right that was never claimed.

4. The applicant applied before the chargesheet was filed. The right was claimed in time and must be given effect.
